summary: Comprehensive testing of Chore Swap system. All 8 chore-swap backend tests pass (trade, give, marketplace, decline/admin-deny, cancel+pending limit, cooldown, validation, summary endpoint). Regression: 19/19 prior backend tests still pass (mini-games, verification, availability, random events, sandbox). Found and fixed one critical frontend integration bug — App.js mapped household members with a typo `odId`/`name` instead of `userId`/`displayName`, which broke the target-housemate dropdown in ChoreSwapPanel. After fix, full E2E flow (trade create → target accept → admin approve → task reassignment + recent-activity log) verified in the browser.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED. App.js householdMembers map produced { name, odId } but ChoreSwapPanel reads { displayName, userId }, leaving the target dropdown with blank/duplicate options and blocking trade/give swap creation with 'Pick a household member' error. Patched to expose both shapes.

issues: Pre-existing /quests endpoint returns 403 when loading game data after user reload (unrelated to chore swap, observed in console).

action_items: Verify the App.js householdMembers mapping fix did not regress any other consumer of householdMembers (search shows it is read elsewhere by other forms that previously used the broken shape and likely also rendered empty — please audit for any other component still reading m.name / m.odId).
Investigate pre-existing /quests 403 console error observed when reloading dashboard for non-admin users (not blocking chore swap).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 1926 had a typo (`odId`, `name`) breaking the ChoreSwapPanel target dropdown — fixed to expose both legacy and canonical keys.
ChoreSwapPanel correctly enforces business rules client-side (hides offer-select unless trade+target chosen) and surfaces server validation errors via [data-testid=chore-swap-error].
Backend cooldown check uses substring match for the test (`'cooldown' in detail or 'swapped recently'`) — message wording is consistent.
Marketplace claim correctly transitions to pending_admin and blocks self-claim and double-claim with 400.
ChoreSwap model + endpoints scope by householdId during DB inspection, avoiding taskId collisions across households as called out by E1.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (trade, marketplace, accept, admin approve all working E2E)

test_credentials: None required - households created via API per test
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a fresh household with 2–3 members via /api/households/create-enhanced + /api/households/join + /api/households/{id}/assign-chores.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chore Swap (trade/give/marketplace) is fully working end-to-end. If you touch App.js dashboard state, be careful with the householdMembers mapping — must continue to expose { userId, displayName } for ChoreSwapPanel. The pre-existing /quests 403 console noise is unrelated. Holiday/business-endorsement APIs remain MOCKED (pre-existing).
